author: Mooch24
body:
This is for the TeamSpeak server. I couldn't fit it in the title :c

The title pretty much says it all. Allow any player to create a custom channel that can be password protected. Creators and members of this channel can spread the password to those they choose. 

Also, please none of this "staff only" crap. That's not what they signed up for.

replies.author: Mooch24
replies.body:
I've seen bickering and very hurtful things said between players that don't cooperate over TS very well. Many times, particular player(s) will follow players around any public chat that they're in. I know the staff's job is to stop this stuff blah blah but it happens all the time and nothing is done.

With the addition of custom channels, players can avoid each other to prevent any possible conflict. There's not that many people on TS at once so there will be, at most, like 3 custom channels on a busy day.

I'll personally look into any custom plugins to make any sort of system easier and more automated.
